authors: Darrell K. Rigby; Jeff Sutherland; Hirotaka Takeuchi

items.meaning: 敏捷的；采用短周期迭代与快速反馈的。
items.definitionEn: Using an iterative approach in which a team delivers small pieces of work and adapts to feedback.
items.usage: 本文用的是管理术语。大写 Agile 也可统称敏捷方法，区别于一般形容身体动作灵活的 agile。
items.exampleEn: The team used agile methods to test each new checkout feature with customers.
items.exampleZh: 团队用敏捷方法让客户试用每一项新结账功能。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 产品上市速度；从开发到推出的快慢。
items.definitionEn: How quickly a product or service can be developed and made available to customers.
items.usage: 提高 speed to market 表示更快上市。time to market 指具体耗时，通常说缩短。
items.exampleEn: Releasing small updates helped the company improve its speed to market.
items.exampleZh: 分批发布小更新帮助公司提高了产品上市速度。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 由上级集中发令并逐级管控的。
items.definitionEn: Based on centralized authority, detailed orders, and close oversight.
items.usage: 用于管理时常带批评色彩，强调决定与监督集中在上层。
items.exampleEn: A command-and-control approach slowed decisions that the field team could have made immediately.
items.exampleZh: 集中发令的管理方式拖慢了本可由一线团队立即作出的决定。

duplicateDecision.reason: 核对原卡与本篇义项后确认同一义项。保留原卡，追加本篇来源与语境。

items.meaning: 企业最高管理层；首席高管群体。
items.definitionEn: The group of highest-ranking executives in an organization.
items.usage: C 来自 chief，如 CEO 和 CFO。可指这些高管整体，也可作定语修饰高管层活动。
items.exampleEn: The C-suite agreed to prioritize the customer portal across all departments.
items.exampleZh: 最高管理层同意让所有部门优先支持客户门户项目。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 职能壁垒；各部门彼此隔离、各自为政的状态。
items.definitionEn: A business function that works in isolation and shares little information or coordination with others.
items.usage: silo 字面是筒仓。本文强调按职能分隔所产生的沟通与协作障碍。
items.exampleEn: Functional silos made it difficult for sales and engineering to agree on a release date.
items.exampleZh: 职能壁垒使销售和工程团队难以就发布日期达成一致。

duplicateDecision.reason: functional silo 是既有 silo 的部门语境，追加来源与搭配。

items.meaning: 俏皮话；简短诙谐的一句评论。
items.definitionEn: A short, witty comment, often made in response to something.
items.usage: 本文作名词，指高管用幽默话语回应自己了解多少敏捷。quip 也可用作动词。
items.exampleEn: When asked about the delay, she made a quip about the project having more approvals than features.
items.exampleZh: 有人问到延期时，她打趣说这个项目的审批比功能还多。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 敏捷开发中长度固定的短迭代周期。
items.definitionEn: A fixed, short work cycle in Scrum during which a team aims to complete an agreed goal.
items.usage: 本义为短跑。Scrum 中用来安排短期目标、交付和复盘。
items.exampleEn: The team planned a two-week sprint to complete the account recovery flow.
items.exampleZh: 团队安排了一个为期两周的迭代来完成账户找回流程。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 限定给一项活动的固定时间段。
items.definitionEn: A fixed period set aside for an activity or piece of work.
items.usage: 强调到时结束或重新评估。sprint 是一种 time box，限时讨论也可以是。
items.exampleEn: The facilitator set a 15-minute time box for discussing the release risks.
items.exampleZh: 主持人给发布风险的讨论设定了十五分钟的时间上限。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 与某项原则、目标或趋势相违背。
items.definitionEn: To conflict with or go against a principle, intention, or trend.
items.usage: counter 作副词与 run 连用，to 后接相违背的原则或方向。
items.exampleEn: Requiring approval for every experiment runs counter to the team’s goal of learning quickly.
items.exampleZh: 每次实验都要求审批，与团队快速学习的目标相违背。
collocations: run counter to the stated goal

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 暂缓处理；把优先级往后排。
items.definitionEn: To give an idea or task lower priority and postpone action on it.
items.usage: 本文为动词，表示把想法暂时搁置。也可用 put something on the back burner 表达同义。
items.exampleEn: We back-burnered the redesign until the billing errors were fixed.
items.exampleZh: 我们暂缓重新设计，先解决计费错误。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 快速大量产出。
items.definitionEn: To produce a large number of things quickly, often repeatedly.
items.usage: 常强调产出速度和数量，有时暗含粗制滥造。本文重在说明创新产出加快。
items.exampleEn: A reusable test environment helped the team churn out prototypes in days.
items.exampleZh: 可复用的测试环境让团队几天内就能快速做出多个原型。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: Scrum。组织团队以短周期解决复杂问题的敏捷框架。
items.definitionEn: An agile framework in which a small cross-functional team works in short cycles and adapts through inspection and feedback.
items.usage: 本文用 Scrum 说明敏捷如何运作。敏捷是更宽泛的方法体系，Scrum 是其中一种框架。
items.exampleEn: The product team adopted Scrum to review progress and adjust priorities every two weeks.
items.exampleZh: 产品团队采用 Scrum，每两周检查进展并调整优先级。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 精益开发。重视持续减少浪费和提升客户价值的开发方法。
items.definitionEn: A development approach that continuously reduces waste and improves the delivery of customer value.
items.usage: lean 在此强调去除不创造价值的步骤，例如重复审批、等待或返工。
items.exampleEn: Lean development helped the group remove two approvals that delayed every release.
items.exampleZh: 精益开发帮助团队去掉了每次发布都造成延误的两道审批。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 看板方法。可视化工作流程、限制在制任务以改善流动。
items.definitionEn: A method for managing work by visualizing flow and limiting how much work is in progress.
items.usage: 本文特别强调缩短交付提前期并减少同时进行的任务。kanban board 是该方法的一种工具。
items.exampleEn: The support team used Kanban to limit how many cases it investigated at once.
items.exampleZh: 客服团队用看板方法限制同时调查的工单数量。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 交付提前期；从需求提出到交付的总耗时。
items.definitionEn: The elapsed time from a request or order to completion or delivery.
items.usage: 在流程管理中通常包括排队和等待。cycle time 常从实际开始处理算起。
items.exampleEn: Reducing the approval queue cut the average lead time for new accounts.
items.exampleZh: 减少审批排队缩短了开立新账户的平均交付时间。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 在制工作；已经开始但尚未完成的任务。
items.definitionEn: Work that has started but has not yet been completed.
items.usage: 常缩写 WIP。看板用在制上限控制同时处理的任务量。
items.exampleEn: Limiting work in process helped the team finish urgent requests before starting new ones.
items.exampleZh: 限制在制工作量帮助团队先完成紧急需求，再开始新的任务。

duplicateDecision.reason: 同一标准词条的连字符变体。本篇敏捷语境指在办工作，保留原卡的制造业释义。

items.meaning: 跨职能的；包含多个专业或部门的。
items.definitionEn: Involving people or work from different business functions or areas of expertise.
items.usage: 常修饰 team 和 collaboration。区别于同一职能内部的合作。
items.exampleEn: A cross-functional team brought designers, engineers, and compliance specialists together.
items.exampleZh: 跨职能团队把设计师、工程师和合规专家组织到了一起。

duplicateDecision.reason: 核对原卡与本篇义项后确认同一义项。保留原卡，追加本篇来源与语境。

items.meaning: 项目负责人。对客户价值和事项优先级负责的角色。
items.definitionEn: The person accountable for the value and prioritization of an agile initiative.
items.usage: 文中也称 product owner。该角色管理价值与优先级，具体如何做由团队决定。
items.exampleEn: The initiative owner reordered the backlog after the interviews revealed a more urgent customer need.
items.exampleZh: 访谈揭示了更紧迫的客户需求，项目负责人据此重新排列待办事项。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 项目组合待办清单；尚未处理的机会和事项的优先列表。
items.definitionEn: A prioritized list of potential initiatives or opportunities across a portfolio.
items.usage: backlog 在敏捷中是可持续更新的工作清单。portfolio 指范围跨多个项目或机会。
items.exampleEn: The leadership team added the billing redesign to its portfolio backlog for review.
items.exampleZh: 领导团队把账单改版列入项目组合待办清单，等候评审。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 按某项标准依次排序。
items.definitionEn: To put items in order according to a criterion such as priority or value.
items.usage: 动词常加连字符。本文强调持续按客户和企业价值重新排序。
items.exampleEn: The team rank-ordered the proposed fixes by customer impact.
items.exampleZh: 团队按对客户的影响为拟议修复事项排序。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 完成标准；团队确认一项工作完成所用的明确条件。
items.definitionEn: An agreed set of criteria a work item or increment must meet to count as complete.
items.usage: 常缩写 DoD。可包括测试通过、文档更新和集成检查等标准。
items.exampleEn: The team’s definition of done required the feature to pass accessibility tests.
items.exampleZh: 团队的完成标准要求功能通过无障碍测试。
collocations: agree on a definition of done

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: Scrum 教练；帮助团队理解、运行和改善 Scrum 流程的人。
items.definitionEn: A Scrum role that helps the team use the framework effectively and address impediments.
items.usage: 本文强调促进流程与减少干扰。优先级由 initiative owner 负责。
items.exampleEn: The Scrum master helped the team resolve a dependency that blocked the sprint goal.
items.exampleZh: Scrum 教练帮助团队解决了阻碍迭代目标的依赖问题。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 集体智慧；团队成员通过有效协作形成的共同解决问题能力。
items.definitionEn: A group’s ability to solve problems by combining the knowledge and contributions of its members.
items.usage: 本文用它描述协作所带来的团队能力，包含角色清晰、平等贡献和高质量互动。
items.exampleEn: Clear turn-taking during discussions helped the group make better use of its collective intelligence.
items.exampleZh: 讨论时有序轮流发言，帮助团队更好地发挥了集体智慧。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 简短站会。用于同步进展、下一步和阻碍。
items.definitionEn: A brief team meeting for sharing progress, upcoming work, and obstacles.
items.usage: 通常每日举行，站立是传统做法。重点是快速同步，深入讨论可另行安排。
items.exampleEn: At the stand-up meeting, Mia flagged a security review that could delay the release.
items.exampleZh: 米娅在站会上指出，一项安全审查可能推迟发布。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 额外的花哨功能或装饰性配置。
items.definitionEn: Attractive extra features that are not essential to a product’s main purpose.
items.usage: 非正式，常带轻微批评，暗示额外功能有趣但并非核心价值。
items.exampleEn: Users preferred a reliable search function to a dashboard full of bells and whistles.
items.exampleZh: 比起花哨功能堆满的仪表盘，用户更喜欢可靠的搜索功能。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 挥霍；不明智地浪费时间、金钱或机会。
items.definitionEn: To waste a valuable resource or opportunity through poor use.
items.usage: 常用 squander something on something，语气比 waste 更强。
items.exampleEn: The committee squandered its only planning session on minor formatting decisions.
items.exampleZh: 委员会把唯一一次规划会议浪费在了琐碎的格式决定上。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 万能药；能解决所有问题的办法。
items.definitionEn: A supposed solution for all problems or difficulties.
items.usage: 常用 no panacea 或 not a panacea，强调某方法只适合一部分情境。
items.exampleEn: Weekly sprints are useful for experiments, but they are no panacea for staffing shortages.
items.exampleZh: 每周迭代有助于实验，却解决不了所有人员短缺问题。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 核心骨干群体；少数经过培养或积极参与的人。
items.definitionEn: A core group of trained or committed people who support an activity or organization.
items.usage: 常用 a cadre of。本文是愿意参与推广敏捷的一小群骨干。
items.exampleEn: A cadre of experienced volunteers coached the first three project teams.
items.exampleZh: 一批有经验的志愿者辅导了首批三个项目团队。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 坚持不接受某项改变的人或团体。
items.definitionEn: A person or group that continues to resist an agreement or change that others have accepted.
items.usage: 本文指拒绝跟随多数人采用新方法的少数人。动词另用 hold out。
items.exampleEn: The last holdout agreed to try the new process after seeing the pilot results.
items.exampleZh: 最后一位坚持反对的人看到试点结果后，同意尝试新流程。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 照着别人已经采取的行动做；跟进。
items.definitionEn: To do the same thing that someone else has already done.
items.usage: 源于牌类游戏跟出相同花色。商务语境常指其他部门或竞争对手随后采取相同做法。
items.exampleEn: The finance team simplified its intake form, and procurement soon followed suit.
items.exampleZh: 财务团队简化了申请表，采购部门很快也照做了。

duplicateDecision.reason: 核对原卡与本篇义项后确认同一义项。保留原卡，追加本篇来源与语境。

items.meaning: 偶然出现却有益的；意外带来机会的。
items.definitionEn: Occurring by chance in a way that turns out to be fortunate or useful.
items.usage: 比 unexpected 多一层有利结果，常描述发现、相遇或机会。
items.exampleEn: A serendipitous conversation with a customer uncovered a new use for the product.
items.exampleZh: 一次偶然的客户谈话发现了产品的一项新用途。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 某种技术、做法或理念的热情推广者。
items.definitionEn: Someone who enthusiastically promotes an idea, practice, or technology.
items.usage: 原义与宗教传道有关。本文用比喻义，指主动传播敏捷经验的人。
items.exampleEn: After the pilot succeeded, its designers became evangelists for continuous user testing.
items.exampleZh: 试点成功后，项目设计师们成了持续用户测试的热情推广者。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 难以理解、仿佛毫无意义的话。
items.definitionEn: Speech or writing that is impossible or very difficult for the listener to understand.
items.usage: 较口语。本文指软件行话对外行像听不懂的胡话，强调听者的体验。
items.exampleEn: The acronym-heavy presentation sounded like gibberish to new hires.
items.exampleZh: 那场塞满缩略语的演示让新员工听得一头雾水。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 瀑布式开发。按预先规划的阶段顺序推进的开发模式。
items.definitionEn: A development model in which work moves through sequential phases such as requirements, implementation, and testing.
items.usage: 名称来自阶段逐级向下流动的比喻。本文用它对比短周期试验和反馈。
items.exampleEn: Under waterfall development, testing began after the design and implementation phases were complete.
items.exampleZh: 在瀑布式开发下，设计和实现两个阶段结束后才开始测试。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 迭代速度；团队每个迭代完成的工作量。
items.definitionEn: The amount of work a team completes during a sprint, often expressed in its own estimation units.
items.usage: 本文是敏捷度量术语。指标依赖团队自身的估算口径，适合辅助本团队规划。
items.exampleEn: The team used its recent velocity to estimate how much work would fit in the next sprint.
items.exampleZh: 团队用近期每个迭代的完成量来估算下一轮可以承担多少工作。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 守破离。先习得规则，再逐步调整，最后能熟练变通的学习过程。
items.definitionEn: A Japanese learning progression from following established forms to adapting them and eventually improvising fluently.
items.usage: 本文借用武道中的三个阶段说明先掌握敏捷方法，再根据结果调整。
items.exampleEn: The coaches used shu-ha-ri to explain why beginners should learn the standard practice first.
items.exampleZh: 教练用守破离说明为什么初学者应先掌握标准做法。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 看板；用不同状态列展示任务及其流转的板子。
items.definitionEn: A visual board that shows work items moving through stages of a workflow.
items.usage: 常用待办、进行中、已完成等列。实体卡片和电子系统都可承载看板。
items.exampleEn: The team moved each request across the kanban board as it progressed.
items.exampleZh: 团队随着处理进展把每项请求在看板上移动到相应列。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 燃尽图；显示剩余工作量随时间变化的图表。
items.definitionEn: A chart that tracks how much work remains as a sprint or project progresses.
items.usage: 纵轴通常为剩余工作量，随时间理想上逐步降至零。燃起图则常显示累计完成量。
items.exampleEn: The burndown chart showed that several large tasks were still unfinished halfway through the sprint.
items.exampleZh: 燃尽图显示迭代过半时，仍有几项大型任务没有完成。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 棘手复杂的；难以解决的。
items.definitionEn: Difficult to understand or solve because several parts are intertwined.
items.usage: 常形容问题、争议或决策。本义与绳结或木结有关。
items.exampleEn: The departments held a joint session to resolve a knotty pricing issue.
items.exampleZh: 各部门召开联合讨论会来解决一个棘手的定价问题。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 根因分析；追查反复出现的问题背后真正原因的过程。
items.definitionEn: A systematic investigation of the underlying causes of a problem.
items.usage: 重点是找出生成问题的机制，避免只处理表面症状。
items.exampleEn: A root cause analysis showed that most delays came from unclear approval ownership.
items.exampleZh: 根因分析表明，多数延误来自审批责任不明确。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 承担过多事项，以至于时间、注意力或资源被摊得过薄。
items.definitionEn: To be stretched across so many tasks or demands that there is not enough capacity to do them well.
items.usage: 常用 spread oneself too thin 或 be spread too thin，可形容人员和资源。
items.exampleEn: The engineering team was spread too thin across seven simultaneous launches.
items.exampleZh: 工程团队同时承担七个发布项目，力量被分得太散。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 某人偏爱或力推的个人项目。
items.definitionEn: A project that someone strongly favors or supports for personal reasons.
items.usage: pet 作定语，含有特别偏爱的意思。本文警惕高管喜爱但企业优先级不高的项目。
items.exampleEn: A shared ranking system kept one executive’s pet project from displacing customer requests.
items.exampleZh: 共同的排序机制防止一位高管偏爱的项目挤占客户需求。

duplicateDecision.reason: 已核对规范词头，既有词本中无同一词条。

items.meaning: 造成长时间停滞的严重堵塞或积压。
items.definitionEn: A blockage that prevents work or decisions from moving forward.
items.usage: 原指原木堵塞河道。本文比喻传统整合流程中长时间无法疏通的积压。
items.exampleEn: The security team cleared the approval logjam by reviewing small changes daily.
items.exampleZh: 安全团队改为每日审查小改动，疏通了审批积压。

duplicateDecision.reason: 核对原卡与本篇义项后确认同一义项。保留原卡，追加本篇来源与语境。

items.meaning: 矩阵式管理。人员同时与职能部门和项目等不同管理维度协作。
items.definitionEn: A management arrangement in which people work across intersecting functions and project or product lines.
items.usage: 常涉及多个汇报或协调关系。本文强调跨职能协作时仍需明确每项决策的负责人。
items.exampleEn: Matrix management let analysts contribute to product teams while staying connected to their technical discipline.
items.exampleZh: 矩阵式管理让分析师参与产品团队，同时保持与本专业部门的联系。

items.meaning: 事后质疑或反复挑战他人已经作出的决定。
items.definitionEn: To question or criticize someone’s judgment, often after a decision has been made.
items.usage: 本文指上级反复质疑已获授权的负责人，削弱其决策空间。也可表示预判他人的想法。
items.exampleEn: The sponsors agreed to offer advice without second-guessing each product decision.
items.exampleZh: 发起人同意提供建议，同时尊重负责人已经作出的各项产品决定。
